v1_compatibility: Original COLUMNS/write_csv unchanged; main Recall@20 remains capped and in percent.

metric_families.tail_primary: tail-eligible users only; macro mean tail_hits/min(20,n_tail_truth)
metric_families.tail_standard: tail-eligible users only; macro mean tail_hits/n_tail_truth
metric_families.tail_contribution: all evaluated users; macro mean tail_hits/min(20,n_all_truth)
metric_families.catalog_coverage: unique recommended original items/full original catalog
metric_families.weighted_recall: macro mean sum_hit (1+train_count)^(-1/2) / sum_truth (1+train_count)^(-1/2); equal weights give STANDARD recall
metric_families.quantization_delta: uint8 minus float32 capped Recall@20; same checkpoint/beta/users/masks/arithmetic/ties

missing_values: Blank/null is unavailable, never zero. analysis_only rows do not invent main metrics.
lineage: modern=local new-format training checkpoint; legacy=registered historical training/control artifact; baseline=pop-only
